name: Trust Without a Lead
jem_summary: Complete one care result: gorilla trust, a raccoon’s washed egg or a hatched caiman’s protection. Another route is attracting an animal through Maned Wolf scent. Calming a Black Bear or earning cougar friendship also qualifies.

pages.title: Trust Without a Lead
pages.text: Complete one care result: gorilla trust, a raccoon’s washed egg or a hatched caiman’s protection. Another route is attracting an animal through Maned Wolf scent. Calming a Black Bear or earning cougar friendship also qualifies.

pages.title: Trust Without a Lead
pages.text: Care unlocks trust and interactions that a lead cannot provide.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Give gorillas bananas from jungle leaves. Toss a chicken egg near water for raccoon taming; carpet makes a bandana. Breed caimans with catfish and stay near hatching eggs for imprinting. Give a Maned Wolf an apple; scent attracts animals. It is not tameable, and its ant-farm bonus is unavailable

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Marmots group in high mountain meadows, accept dandelions and flee predators.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Sasquatch is normally peaceful; listen for tree-knocking in forests and avoid provocation.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Wet-biome geese accept kelp but retaliate when provoked.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Wet-forest Pit Vipers prefer raw rabbit; close approach risks a dangerous bite.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Beavers occur sparsely in wet habitats, accept apples and periodically chew wood; this is not proven player-controlled logging.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Offer eggs to woodland Skunks; crowding provokes nauseating defensive vapor.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Timber Wolves hunt deer and elk in packs and favor rotten flesh; protect herds and do not infer taming from feeding.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: The greywolf text repeats Timber Wolf description; that is a guide alias, not proof of identical entity implementation.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Cold-biome Wolverines are strong and hunt wildlife/people; raw venison is food, not guaranteed friendship.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Dry-biome Chupacabras hunt livestock and players; protect farms rather than assuming universal taming.
